subject: Privatelisting: Commercial governance & DocuSign workflow for Meridian Health
messages:
From: Samantha Park <samantha.park@meridianhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Meredith Johnson <meredith.johnson@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Privatelisting: Commercial governance & DocuSign workflow for Meridian Health

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the call this morning. Meridian is ready to move forward with the Azure Private Listing (privatelist) but we need to lock down the DocuSign flow and a few commercial governance items before procurement can cut a PO. Can you confirm:

- Who will be the signer on the Redwood side (name + title)?
- Which legal entity will appear on the DocuSign (Redwood Inference, Inc. or Redwood Platform LLC)?
- Do you have a standard SOW template we should include as an attachment?

Also, procurement asked for a single consolidated invoice cadence (monthly) and an explicit SLA clause in the private-offer exhibit. Meredith is on copy for legal redlines.

For attachments we expect: initial private-offer PDF, SOW, and any SOC/attestation exhibits. If you can send over the DocuSign envelope link and expected signers, we can route to our Legal + Procurement queue.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Meridian Health

Attachments: (referenced)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Park <samantha.park@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Privatelisting: Commercial governance & DocuSign workflow for Meridian Health

Samantha —

Great to hear Meridian is ready. Quick answers and next steps below.

Signer & legal entity:
- Signer on Redwood side: Marissa Cole (VP, Commercial Ops).
- Legal entity on the agreement: Redwood Inference, Inc.

Attachments: I am attaching the initial private-offer (Redwood_PrivateOffer_v1.pdf) and our standard SOW template (SOW_Meridian_Integration.docx). Irene from Legal is looped in for any clause-level questions (DPA/data residency/SLA).

DocuSign workflow:
- I will create the envelope and populate Meridian signers as you confirm names.
- Our standard flow is: Meridian Legal -> Meridian Procurement -> Redwood Legal (Irene) -> Redwood Commercial Ops (Marissa) -> Redwood Signer (Marissa).
- Expected time to send envelope: EOD Wed 9/22 if we have final signers and PO routing info.

Commercial governance asks:
- Invoice cadence: monthly is fine; I'll update the invoice exhibit in the private-offer.
- SLA exhibit: please flag the specific SLA items Meridian needs (uptime threshold, credits cadence). We can accept the standard uptime SLA with a negotiated credit cap; Irene will confirm.

Next actions for Meridian: please send the full list of signers (name, title, email) and confirm whether PO routing needs a copy to accounts-payable@meridianhealth.com. Also, if Meridian requires a DocuSign signer authentication step (phone or access code), flag that now.

Irene and Marissa — can you both review the redlines once Meredith sends? If anything is non-standard we will escalate to Legal leadership and update the timeline.

Thanks — attaching docs now.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_PrivateOffer_v1.pdf; SOW_Meridian_Integration.docx

From: Meredith Johnson <meredith.johnson@meridianhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Samantha Park <samantha.park@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Privatelisting: Commercial governance & DocuSign workflow for Meridian Health

Mateo / Samantha —

Attached are Meridian's initial redlines (Redlined_Agreement_Meridian.pdf). High level: we have marked up the DPA references (data residency & breach notification timing), limited liability caps that reference our internal procurement policy, and requested a one-calendar-year termination-for-convenience notice period.

Two specific questions for Redwood:
1) Can you confirm whether the Azure Private Listing entitles Meridian to a consolidated monthly invoice or does the marketplace force split billing by SKU? Procurement needs consolidated monthly to reconcile with internal chargeback.
2) For DocuSign, we require signer authentication via access code for the Meridian Legal signer.

We plan to route to procurement today once we get confirmation on the invoice consolidation and the DocuSign auth.

Regards,
Meredith Johnson
Sr. Counsel, Meridian Health

Attachments: Redlined_Agreement_Meridian.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Meredith Johnson <meredith.johnson@meridianhealth.com>, Samantha Park <samantha.park@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Privatelisting: Commercial governance & DocuSign workflow for Meridian Health

Meredith / Samantha —

Thanks for the redlines and the clear asks. Quick responses inline: 

- Invoice consolidation: We can support a consolidated monthly invoice for Meridian. Merchant-portal metering will report per-SKU to Azure, but Redwood will issue a single consolidated monthly invoice to Meridian's billing contact (accounts-payable@meridianhealth.com). I'll note this in the invoice exhibit and include the billing routing in the DocuSign envelope.

- DocuSign authentication: Access-code authentication is fine. I'll build the envelope to require an access code for the Meridian Legal signer; please provide the contact number/email we should use to send the code.

On redlines: Irene reviewed the redline PDF and flagged three clauses that need escalation from Redwood Legal: the proposed unlimited data retention carve-out; the increased liability cap referencing vendor negligence; and the contravention of our standard termination notice window. We can accept Meridian's edits on the DPA timing for breach notifications (48 hrs is reasonable) and the invoice cadence. 

Proposed path:
- I will update the private-offer with the invoice exhibit and DocuSign flow and upload a revised agreement v1.1 to the envelope by EOD today.
- Meridian to confirm signer contact for the access-code.
- If Meridian can accept our proposed compromise language for liability caps (mutual cap tied to 12 months of fees), we can avoid a long legal escalation. If not, we will need to route to legal leadership (Irene will cover).

Timeline: aiming to have envelope out by 9/22 EOD and fully signed by 9/27 assuming no additional escalations. If procurement needs a PO before signature we can accept a pre-PO routing with the signed DocuSign to follow.

I'll upload the revised docs to the DocuSign link below and drop a HubSpot note for tracking.

DocuSign envelope (draft): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/12345678-privatelist-meridian
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/contacts/DEAL-8392

Best,
— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
